groups.name: Remove groupingThreshold configuration key
groups.rationale: Eliminates the configurable threshold and fixes the logic so every diff of two files or more goes to the model instead of being served alphabetically.
groups.watch: The config must still accept `groupingThreshold` from older configurations without failing, but the value must be ignored entirely—the skip condition is now hardcoded to `files.length <= 1`.

groups.name: Update documentation and user-facing text
groups.rationale: Reflects the removal of the configurable threshold and clarifies that only single-file diffs skip grouping because there is nothing to order.
groups.watch: The reason message in grouped output must match the new skip condition—the old threshold-based message is gone.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
